about: This page is React (src/pages/brand/BrandPage.jsx). tools/split-map.js stops generating it, drops the legacy functions below, and fails if anything left still calls them. brandModal was built at runtime by showModalHtml (not a source modal), so it is rendered by the page and not listed under modals. BRAND_FIELDS_SERVED, BRAND_REACH_NOTE and BRAND_JSON_FIELDS are the page's own constants (now in BrandPage.jsx).
